canonical_statement: A U.S. senator represents the citizens of their entire state.
linked_questions: Who does a U.S. senator represent?
curation_rationale: Only meaningful phrasing. Paired with fact 32 (who elects senators) as a represents/elected-by pair, even though the answer text is nearly identical — not a Question merge like the Declaration/Civil War cases, since 'who a senator represents' and 'who elects a senator' are genuinely distinct relationships, just about the same population.
visual_treatment: Paired with fact 32 in the 'senate_relationship' cluster.

canonical_statement: U.S. senators are elected by citizens of their state.

canonical_statement: Your U.S. senators depend on which state you live in — look this up at senate.gov before your interview.
linked_questions: Who is one of your state's U.S. senators now?
curated_answer: Varies by state — look up at senate.gov
curation_rationale: Not curatable with a fixed answer — genuinely depends on the reader's state. Matches the 'check locally' punt on state-specific content, decided as out-of-scope-for-curation at the very start of this project. Given a distinct icon (map pin) rather than any of the content icons, to visually signal 'this one is on you to look up' rather than implying a memorizable fact.
visual_treatment: Map pin icon, distinct from every other icon family in the book.
